description: National Roads is a digital representation of Australia's road network in the Digital Atlas of Australia. Its linear features describe surfaces improved for vehicle, pedestrian and bicycle travel on land, and ferry routes that carry vehicles across water; railways, tramways, driveways and passenger-only ferry routes are excluded. It gives an optimised, aggregated national view of road geometry and attributes built from multiple sources, including jurisdictional data revised regularly and supplied in varying formats and quality, and its stated purpose is a single national road representation for visualisation, analysis and logistics planning at national and local scale. Coverage is national, with 4,357,120 features in the service. It is free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (Geoscape Roads copyright Geoscape Australia) with open access, as an ArcGIS feature service and a web map combining national and major roads. Caveats: quality varies with the source jurisdiction, and the Geoscape copyright and disclaimer notice applies. The network supports road network flow, routing, criticality and hazard exposure analysis. It complements the Foundation Rail Infrastructure dataset and BITRE's heavy vehicle median speeds.
